verdict.rationale: The only documented create-edit-export loop is for images: Gemini generates and refines images, supports local edits to parts of an image, and lets you download them at 1K or 2K resolution. Nothing in the evidence shows it creating or iteratively editing documents or presentations, and generic writing help and editing content in connected apps are adjacent features, not file creation with export. Missing for 10: document creation and iterative editing, presentation/slide generation, export to office formats (e.g. DOCX/PPTX/PDF), and any hands-on corroboration.
